boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named Allentown walking destinations from the City’s free Million Clicks walking program.

cards.title: Walk LifeTrail together
cards.subtitle: Cedar Creek Parkway · Allentown
cards.notes: Meet at the trail across from the pavilions and enter from Honochick Drive. Walk the route at an easy group pace, then use the benches for a reset.
cards.short_summary: A named Cedar Creek Parkway trail stop for an unstructured outdoor catch-up.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists LifeTrail in Cedar Creek Parkway as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: trail across from pavilions; enter on Honochick Drive. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Take the Trexler Park loop
cards.subtitle: Trexler Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Start near the pond at the main trail entrance off Springhouse Road. Keep the plan simple: walk a loop, pause by the water, and head out before dusk.
cards.short_summary: A pond-side trail entrance for a no-cost group walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Trexler Park’s main trail entrance near the pond as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: main trail entrance near the pond; enter on Springhouse Road. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Stretch your legs at Andre Reed Park
cards.subtitle: Andre Reed Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Use the park sign near Irving Street as the meetup point, then take a conversational walk through the park. Bring water if needed; no ticket or purchase is part of this plan.
cards.short_summary: A named city park stop for an easy walk and conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Andre Reed Park as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: near the park sign; enter on Irving Street. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk the Hamilton Mile
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Street and 7th Street · Downtown Allentown
cards.notes: Gather by PPL Center at Hamilton and 7th Streets, then make the city block walk your hang. Keep it to public sidewalks and use crosswalks for the route.
cards.short_summary: A downtown walking checkpoint centered on a named arena landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Hamilton Mile at PPL Center, at Hamilton and 7th Streets, as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions identify PPL Center at Hamilton and 7th Streets. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.entity_name: Lehigh Parkway Robin Hood Bridge Trail
cards.title: Meet by Robin Hood Bridge
cards.subtitle: Lehigh Parkway · Allentown
cards.notes: Enter through 15th Street and use the trail near Robin Hood Bridge for a low-key walk. Stay on the marked route and schedule the outing while the park is open.
cards.short_summary: A named Lehigh Parkway trail point anchored by Robin Hood Bridge.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Lehigh Parkway trail near Robin Hood Bridge as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: trail near Robin Hood Bridge; enter through 15th Street. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk to the Covered Bridge
cards.subtitle: Lehigh Parkway · Allentown
cards.notes: Use the trail near the Covered Bridge as a clear meetup landmark. Make the outing a stroll and photo stop, while following posted park rules and leaving before dusk.
cards.short_summary: A bridge-centered Lehigh Parkway walk with an identifiable landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Lehigh Parkway trail near the Covered Bridge as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions identify the trail near the Covered Bridge. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Circle West Park’s bandshell
cards.subtitle: West Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Meet at the kiosk near the bandshell, then take a lap through the park and linger on a bench to talk. This is a daytime outdoor plan with no purchase built in.
cards.short_summary: A park walk that uses the bandshell kiosk as its rendezvous point.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists West Park’s kiosk near the bandshell as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: kiosk near the bandshell. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk Jordan Park’s trail
cards.subtitle: Jordan Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Find the trail across from the basketball courts and set a relaxed walking loop. Use the courts as a visible landmark, but keep the activity to the free public walk.
cards.short_summary: A trail meetup beside Jordan Park’s basketball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Jordan Park’s trail across from the basketball courts as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: near the trail, across from basketball courts. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk from Roosevelt Park’s court
cards.subtitle: Roosevelt Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Meet near the basketball-court parking area on South Filmore Street, then take a short social walk in the park. Plan to finish before dusk under city park rules.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable court-side starting point for a free outdoor walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Roosevelt Park near the basketball court parking lot as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: South Filmore Street, near the basketball-court parking lot. The City states, “Walking is free.”

cards.title: Walk the canal park trail
cards.subtitle: Lehigh Canal Park · Allentown
cards.notes: Use the trail near the boathouse as the meeting marker, entering at East Walnut and South Albert Streets. Walk with friends and skip the water; city rules prohibit swimming.
cards.short_summary: A canal-side walking destination marked by its boathouse.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Lehigh Canal Park’s trail near the boathouse as a Million Clicks walking location and states that walking is free.
cards.source_title: Million Clicks for Million Hearts | City of Allentown
cards.access_notes: City directions: East Walnut Street and South Albert Street, trail near the boathouse. The City states, “Walking is free.”
